name: stock_writeoff
description: GH #3746 / REQ-715, docs/assets/stock-workflow-documents.md. The header of a stock write-off document. Same shape as the stock_receipt header without counterparty_id, supplier_document_ref and received_on. document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number and the issued time. org_unit_id is the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). event_time is the time of the movement, ISO 8601 with offset, stored in UTC. location_id and responsible_id are record ids of modules locations and org (no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). Written only by module stock; after issue nothing of the header changes.
